en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_anal_ongoing: The schedule turns to 'anal day', and $names$ is strapped onto the dedicated table.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_anal_result: The morning's first task: an enema. Hose and bag, both prepared by his own hands.
en-us.event_erav_sm_anal_01:
"A dirty passage makes for an unusable toy." The old man raises the water bag.
"Endure it. Hold it. Count to a hundred before you may go."
She begs at sixty. He is unmoved and raises the bag another inch. "Miscounted. Start over. A toy doesn't act on its own initiative." Three fill-and-drain rounds before he lets her up.
en-us.event_erav_sm_anal_02:
The stretching begins with fingers, moves to a cone-shaped trainer, then to something like a numbing tail - worn while she sits straight, kneels straight, serves tea, bows.
"Drop it, and time is added." By supper she has earned three extensions.
en-us.event_erav_sm_anal_03:
Evening brings 'inspection'. Bent over the training rack, she is taken from behind.
The repeatedly-stretched entrance burns - and deep inside the burn a heat from being filled pools, a heat she dare not admit to.
en-us.event_erav_sm_anal_04:
"Record: sphincter tolerance good. Reflex contraction still present - a fine sign. A toy with no reactions at all would be dull."
He closes the notebook. "Tomorrow: bondage endurance. Today's added time comes out of tomorrow morning."
